capturedRoomScreenCheck.method: Direct source X/Y in room placement order; complement each bitmap bit before mapping the record's 48K attribute ink/paper to RGB.

bitmapFormat: height in pixels, width in bytes, height-times-width 1-bit MSB-first bitmap bytes, then attribute height in 8-pixel rows, attribute width in bytes and per-cell attribute bytes
limits: The local preview draws 1-bit shapes with an optional approximate ink/paper palette. FLASH timing, layering, transparency and animation remain unverified in the native compositor.
